name: Gehrman's Sequence
lore: D G A G D A C G — eight steps. He set the tempo to 95 BPM and left the workshop running when the Hunt started. It is still running.

name: Cathedral Fog
lore: A slow vibrato breathes through vast reverb. Like standing inside a tolling bell.

name: Blood Resonance
lore: The ladder filter screams at high resonance — a frequency only the mad can hear.

name: The Hunter's Tremor
lore: An LFO sweeps the filter open and shut. The darkness pulses like a heartbeat.

name: Echo Wraith
lore: Whatever you play, it repeats. And repeats. Slightly quieter each time. Until it isn't.

name: The Bell Tolls
lore: A pure tone decays through reverb and delay. The church bells of a dead city.

name: The Ritual Cantor
lore: A sequencer pattern loops endlessly. Filtered. Saturated. Eternal.

name: Nightmare Sweep
lore: The filter opens then closes, then opens. You can't stop it. You don't want to.

name: Void Drone
lore: Sub-bass with slow vibrato. The ground beneath Moogham, still trembling.

name: Pale Sequence
lore: A fast arpeggiated pattern, bright as a blade, through the filter and into delay.

name: Hollow Pulse
lore: A square wave with a punchy envelope and heavy drive. Industrial. Relentless.

name: Ghost Choir
lore: Triangle wave through chorus — a hundred voices made from one, shimmering in the dark.

name: Drowned Tongue
lore: A sawtooth through formant shaping — the sound of a drowned entity trying to speak.

name: Phase Haunting
lore: A slowly sweeping phaser on a sine wave. The sound seems to move without moving.

name: Dream Sequence
lore: The Turing Machine generates a pattern that sounds intentional but came from mathematics.

name: Tape Séance
lore: One oscillator, two destinations simultaneously — this is parallel routing. Warm tape saturation on one path, vast reverb on the other. Neither interferes with the other. The signal splits.

name: Modulated Ladder
lore: An LFO sweeps the Ladder filter open and closed as the sequencer plays. Four poles of resonant silk, sculpted by a wave at 0.3 Hz. This is what Moog dreamed about.

name: The Haunted Choir
lore: Serial and parallel at once. VCO through filter, filter through chorus for shimmer — while raw VCO also feeds reverb for bloom. Two separate paths from one source. This is the architecture of everything.

name: Folded Nightmare
lore: A sawtooth folded past itself four times. Each fold mirrors the waveform back, adding dense odd harmonics the original signal never contained. Then into reverb. Metallic. Vast. Alive.

name: Bell Wraith
lore: Ring modulation multiplies two frequencies together, producing sum and difference tones that neither source contains. At ratio 3.5:1, the result is an inharmonic bell. Into reverb and delay — it decays like a memory.

name: Sweep and Echo
lore: LFO sweeps the filter. The filtered signal branches: reverb on one side, delay on the other. Four cables. The sweep breathes. The reverb blooms. The delay leaves ghosts. This is a full patch.

name: Three-Path Drone
lore: Filtered signal feeds both reverb and delay simultaneously — two effects sharing one chain. Sub-bass triangle, slow envelope, high resonance. Watch the waveform: the filter makes the sound physical.

name: The Wound Sequence
lore: The LFO modulates pitch instead of the filter this time. A slow warble across each sequenced note. The melody breathes unevenly, as if in pain. A minor, 72 BPM — melancholy with a pulse.

name: Vowel Apparition
lore: Formant filters carve vocal resonances from a sine wave. Three bandpass peaks positioned where human vocal cavities resonate. At Q=18, each vowel shape rings on its own. Select vowels live.

name: The Architect's Sequence
lore: Three cables. Ladder filter under LFO modulation. Filtered signal into delay. Sequencer at 104 BPM. This is what a complete patch sounds like — each module doing one job, all jobs interlocking.
